{{short description|American aeronautical engineer}}
{{Use mdy dates|date=August 2025}}
'''Doris Cohen''' was  a twentieth-century American mathematician and aerodynamicist.  She worked at the [[Langley Memorial Aeronautical Laboratory]] of the [[National Advisory Committee for Aeronautics]] (NACA, a precursor to [[NASA]]).  In 1941, a research report she published made her NACA's first female author.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.theguardian.com/books/2017/feb/05/hidden-figures-black-female-scientists-african-americans-margot-lee-shetterly-space-race|newspaper=[[The Guardian]]|first=Margot Lee|last=Shetterly|author-link=Margot Lee Shetterly|title=The hidden history of Nasa's black female scientists|date=February 5, 2017}}</ref>

She was married to, and worked with, aerodynamicist [[Robert Thomas Jones (engineer)|R. T. Jones]].  With him, she co-founded [[Vega Instrument]] Co., a telescope manufacturing company, in 1957.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://web.stanford.edu/dept/news/pr/99/jonesobit.html|title=Aerodynamics pioneer R. T. Jones dies (8/99)|publisher=}}</ref>

# ''An Analysis of the Stability of an Airplane with Free Controls'' with [[Robert Thomas Jones (engineer)|Robert T. Jones]] (1941)
# ''A Graphical Method of Determining Pressure Distribution in Two-dimensional Flow'' with Robert T. Jones  (1941)
# ''Theoretical Distribution of Load over a Swept-back Wing'' (1942)
# ''A method for determining the camber and twist of a surface to support a given distribution of lift'' (1942)
# ''Determination of optimum plan forms for control surfaces'' with  Robert T. Jones  (1942)
# ''A Theoretical Investigation of the Rolling Oscillations of an Airplane with Ailerons Free'' (1944)
# ''Analytical Investigation of the Stability of an F8F Dropping Model with Automatic Stabilization'' (1945)
# ''A method for determining the camber and twist of a surface to support a given distribution of lift, with applications to the load over a sweptback wing'' (1945)
# ''The Theoretical Lift of Flat Swept-back Wings at Supersonic Speeds'' (1948)
# ''Theoretical Loading at Supersonic Speeds of Flat Swept-back Wings with Interacting Trailing and Leading Edges'' (1949)
# ''Formulas and Charts for the Supersonic Lift and Drag of Flat Swept-back Wings with Interacting Leading and Trailing Edges'' (1950)
# ''Formulas for the Supersonic Loading, Lift, and Drag of Flat Swept-Back Wings with Leading Edges Behind the Mach Line'' (1951)
# ''Theoretical Investigation of the Supersonic Lift and Drag of Thin, Sweptback Wings with Increased Sweep near the Root'' with [[Morris D. Friedman]] (1953)
# ''Arrangement of Fusiform Bodies to Reduce the Wave Drag at Supersonic Speeds'' with Morris D Friedman  (1954)
